freeze_conditions: TON-IoT type unique-value inventory completed (read-only pass)
Official field/statistics documents of all three datasets reviewed
TON-IoT label semantics re-verified against official description

binary_label.role: the only mandatory cross-dataset unified label

ton_iot.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 45: 'Tag normal and attack records, where 0 indicates normal and 1 indicates attacks'

ciciot2023.rule: Benign_Final -> benign; the other 33 categories -> attack

n_baiot.rule: benign_traffic.csv -> benign; gafgyt_attacks_extracted/ and mirai_attacks_extracted/ contents -> attack
n_baiot.special_case: root-level demonstrate_structure.csv is zero-row and never enters any pipeline, so it receives no label

canonical_family.role: conservative standardized family for within-dataset multiclass and genuinely-shared cross-dataset comparison

absent_families.rule: statement of coverage, never a negative class; families are never forced into an 'other' bucket for alignment

fixed_decisions.rule: Gafgyt tcp/udp are NOT re-labelled as ddos; Gafgyt scan is NOT merged into recon; malware family and behavior type are different axes. A separate behavior_tag may be added later if evidence supports it but never replaces canonical_family.
fixed_decisions.evidence_source: Meidan et al. 2018 (references/dataset_docs/n_baiot/meidan2018_arxiv_v1_2026-09-04.pdf, p.4): 'BASHLITE (also known as Gafgyt, Q-Bot, Torlus, Lizard-Stresser, and Lizkebab)'

canonical_family.note: Final family assignments are NOT frozen until the TON-IoT type inventory is complete and official documents are reviewed.

ton_iot_type_mapping.description: Mapping of the 9 TON-IoT attack type values plus normal to canonical_family. All 10 entries carry decision_status=frozen as TON-IOT-TYPE-MAPPING-20260904-V1-FROZEN (frozen from evidence v3 ZIP f774457585db719bc223a89cc965aabef7019bec1f0f6209a0ce160e3a4eecc4, source commit b95e7bc).

entries.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 45 (label=0 -> normal) + row 46 (type=normal); TON-IoT label census: 50,000 rows with label=0 and type=normal
entries.rationale: Direct 1:1 mapping; verified invariant: all label=0 rows have type=normal and vice versa (census confirmed zero exceptions). This is a coverage invariant, not one of the 9 attack classes.

entries.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 46 lists backdoor as an attack category; Statistics of Network Records.pdf lists 20,000 backdoor rows in train/test
entries.rationale: Identity-preserving mapping: the official TON-IoT source label is retained without semantic broadening. Detailed attack mechanisms are not inferred from the selected dataset documentation.

entries.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 46 lists DDoS as an attack category; Statistics of Network Records.pdf lists 20,000 ddos rows in train/test
entries.rationale: Identity-preserving mapping: the official TON-IoT source label is retained without semantic broadening. Detailed attack mechanisms are not inferred from the selected dataset documentation. CICIoT2023 also carries a DDoS category; candidate for cross-dataset family comparison, subject to separate CICIoT2023 mapping freeze and subtype-coverage audit.

entries.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 46 lists scanning as an attack category; Statistics of Network Records.pdf lists 20,000 scanning rows in train/test; UNB CICIoT2023 official taxonomy (https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/iotdataset-2023.html) places Port Scan, OS Scan, Host Discovery, Ping Sweep, and Vulnerability Scan under the Recon category
entries.rationale: Scanning maps to canonical_family=recon as a derived mapping (source_type name differs from canonical_family name). The UNB CICIoT2023 official taxonomy explicitly places Port/OS/Vulnerability Scan under Recon, supporting scanning as a reconnaissance activity. Note: this does NOT merge Gafgyt scan into recon — that is a malware family subtype on a different axis. Candidate for cross-dataset family comparison, subject to separate CICIoT2023 mapping freeze and subtype-coverage audit.

entries.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 46 lists xss as an attack category; Statistics of Network Records.pdf lists 20,000 xss rows in train/test; UNB CICIoT2023 official taxonomy (https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/iotdataset-2023.html) places Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) under the Web-based category
entries.rationale: XSS maps to canonical_family=web_attack as a derived mapping (specific XSS to broader web_attack). The UNB CICIoT2023 official taxonomy places XSS under the Web-based category, supporting this family placement. Candidate for cross-dataset family comparison, subject to separate CICIoT2023 mapping freeze and subtype-coverage audit.

entries.evidence_source: Network Features-Description.pdf row 46 lists attack categories including normal, DoS, DDoS and backdoor attacks; Statistics of Network Records.pdf lists 1,043 mitm rows in train/test
entries.rationale: Identity-preserving mapping: the official TON-IoT source label is retained without semantic broadening. Detailed attack mechanisms are not inferred from the selected dataset documentation. The 1,043-row count is a natural imbalance point (the only attack class below 20,000), not an error. CICIoT2023 does carry a MITM-ArpSpoofing source subtype, but its official taxonomy places ARP spoofing under the Spoofing category; no cross-dataset MITM comparison is made until the CICIoT2023 mapping freeze.

coverage_invariant.rule: normal -> benign must hold for all rows; all label=0 rows must have type=normal and vice versa
coverage_invariant.evidence_source: TON-IoT label census (TON-IOT-LABEL-CENSUS-20260903-V1-VERIFIED): 50,000 label=0 rows all have type=normal; 161,043 label=1 rows all have type in {backdoor,ddos,dos,injection,password,ransomware,scanning,xss,mitm}; zero exceptions

source_subtype.role: official original labels, verbatim; never a cross-dataset unified task

per_dataset.n_baiot: family directory + CSV filename, verbatim, stored as source_family and source_subtype

grouping_metadata.role: provenance and group-aware splits only; never model features

notes.capture_id: CICIoT2023: filename stem (e.g. DDoS-ACK_Fragmentation12); N-BaIoT: device+family+subtype triple; TON-IoT: not available in the selected train_test_network.csv

ton_iot.label_location: label column (0/1) + type column (attack subtype string)

special_case.location: root of the extracted tree, not inside any device directory
special_case.disposition: retained in frozen inventory as shipped; never enters training, evaluation, or label assignment
